entries.source: Take advantage of speed and shield to fight in close quarters.
entries.target: 利用速度与盾牌的优势进行近身战斗。

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the ritch tunnels.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查一下里奇通道。#WHITE#

entries.source: Always display combat properties of shields even if you don't know shield attack talents.#WHITE#
entries.target: 永远显示盾牌的战斗数据，不管你有没有学会盾牌攻击技能。#WHITE#

entries.source: supple leather armour entwined with willow bark
entries.target: 与柳树皮交织的柔韧皮甲

entries.source: %d%% chance to get a more powerful summon.
entries.target: %d%% 几率召唤出更强大的召唤物。

entries.source: It is part of a set of items.
entries.target: 它是某个套装中的一件。

entries.source: I am looking for staff training.
entries.target: 我想寻求法杖战斗训练。

entries.source: Your will carries you through the most difficult struggles, allowing you to fight on when others would have collapsed from exhaustion.
entries.target: 你的意志支撑你熬过最艰难的苦战，让你在别人早已因精疲力竭而倒下时仍能继续战斗。

entries.source: The portal brought you to what seems to be a cell in the basement of the tower. You must escape!
entries.target: 传送门将你送到了一座高塔地下室中的牢房里。你必须逃离！

entries.source:
This giant golem was constructed by the Halflings during the Pyre Wars to fight the orcs, but was felled by Garkul the Devourer.
Its body is made of marble, its joints of solid voratun, and its eyes of purest ruby. One of its eyes seems to be missing. At over 40 feet high it towers above you.
Someone foolish has tried to reconstruct it, but it seems like it misses an eye to be completed.
entries.target:
这尊巨型傀儡是由半身人在烈火战争期间为对抗兽人而建造的，但它被吞噬者加库尔击倒了。
它的身体由大理石制成，关节由坚实的沃瑞钽制成，双眼则由最纯净的红宝石制成。它似乎缺了一只眼睛。它高逾四十英尺，高高耸立在你面前。
有个蠢货试图重新建造它，但要完成似乎还差一只眼睛。

entries.source: Turn into pure lightning, moving %d%% faster. It also increases your lightning resistance by 100%% and your physical resistance by 30%%.
entries.target: 成为一道闪电，提高 %d%% 移动速度。并提高 100%%闪电抗性和 30%%物理抗性。

entries.source:
Focus your mind on a single target, diverting all offensive Discharge talent effects to it for %d turns.  While this effect is active, all Discharge talents gain %d%% critical power and you ignore %d%% mind resistance of your targets.
		If the target is killed, the effect will end early.
		At level level 5 your single-minded focus also resets the cooldown of Mind Storm.
		The damage bonus will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
将注意力集中于单体目标，将所有攻击性灵能脉冲系技能射向目标，持续 %d 回合。当此技能激活时，所有灵能脉冲系技能增加 %d%% 暴击伤害，并且你可以获得 %d%% 精神抗性穿透。
		如果目标死亡，则该技能提前中断。
		技能等级 5 时，你一心一意的注意力也会重置心灵风暴技能的冷却时间。
		受精神强度影响，暴击增益效果按比例加成。

entries.source: Ah yes, Angolwen, I have called it home for many years...
entries.target: 啊，安格利文，我多年来一直把那里当作家……

entries.source: #0080FF#The furious lightning storm around %s calms down and disappears.
entries.target: #0080FF#围绕着%s的闪电风暴沉寂了下来并消失了。

entries.source: %s unshutters %s %s, unleashing a torrent of shadows!
entries.target: %s打开了%s%s，释放出一股暗影洪流！

entries.source: Fashioned by Grand Smith Dakhtun in the Age of Allure, these dwarven-steel gauntlets have been etched with golden arcane runes and are said to grant the wearer unparalleled physical and magical might.
entries.target: 厄流纪由大师级铁匠打造而成。那些矮人钢臂铠镂刻着晦涩难懂的金色符文，据说它们可以赋予穿戴者强大的魔武力量。

entries.source: A headless, gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach.
entries.target: 一个无头、四肢细长的人形怪物，腹部巨大而鼓胀。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 魔法，+2 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source:
Fire off a quick sling bullet for %d%% damage at double your normal attack speed, as well as increasing your attack speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		Each time you move, the cooldown of this talent is reduced by 1.
entries.target:
发射一枚快速的石弹，造成 %d%% 伤害，攻击速度是你普通攻击的两倍。增加你攻击速度 %d%%，持续5回合。
		移动将会降低技能冷却 1 回合。

entries.source:
Create a perfect lookalike of your own form made out of pure light near a creature.
		This image has %d life and can never take more than 1 damage per creature per turn and is immune to any non direct damage (ground effects, damage over time, ...).
		Whenever you cast a spell your mirror image will try to duplicate it at the same target for 66%% less damage, if possible. If it can, it will lose 1 life, if not it will instead taunt a creature to focus its attention on itself.
		While the image exists you receive the damage bonus from the Invisibility spell as if you were invisible.
		This spell can not be cast while a Mirror Image already exists and only in combat. It will disappear after a few turn when outside of combat.
entries.target:
在某个生物的身旁，召唤一个由纯粹的光线构成的，与你完全相似的完美复制体。
		这一镜像具有 %d 生命值，每回合从每个生物身上最多受到 1 点伤害，且免疫任何非直接伤害（地面效果，持续伤害，等等）
		当你释放任何法术的时候，镜像也会试图对同一目标释放这一法术，造成的伤害降低 66%%。如果它这么做了，它会流失 1 点生命值。如果不能的话，它则会嘲讽一个生物，将它的注意力集中在自己身上。
		只要镜像持续存在在战场上，你就会获得隐形技能所基于的隐形伤害加成，无论你是否隐形。
		这一技能无法在场上已经有镜像的时候释放，且只能在战斗中释放。镜像在脱战后快速消失。
%s将%s %s紧贴自身，净化%s身上的腐化！

entries.source: You cannot switch equipment while sleeping!
entries.target: 你不能在睡眠中切换装备！

entries.source: Activate the infusion to heal for %d%% of all damage taken (calculated before resistances) and reduce the duration of a random debuff by %d each turn for %d turns.
entries.target: 激活这个纹身，你受到的伤害将部分转化为治疗（在伤害减免之前计算），转化比例为 %d%%。此外，每回合减少一个随机负面效果的持续时间 %d 回合，持续 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Partially dissipates all incoming damage, reducing it by 30%%, up to a maximum of %d.
		The maximum damage reduction will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
分解一部分受到的伤害。减少 30%% 伤害，最多减少 %d。
		减少伤害的最大值受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Feed on the pain you cause your foes.
			For 2 turns you gain %d%% lifesteal on all damage dealt.
			The lifesteal will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
从你对敌人的痛苦中汲取力量。
			在 2 回合内，你的所有伤害获得 %d%% 的吸血。
			吸血比例受法术强度加成。

entries.source: #Target# is free from the corrosive worm.

#{bold}#
Lyrissa the Wyrmfriend
#{normal}#93 - 116#{italic}#
Eaten by dragons
#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#
好龙者莉莉莎
#{normal}#93 - 116#{italic}#
被龙吃了
#{normal}#

entries.source:
Corrosive fumes rise from the ground doing %0.2f acid damage in a radius of 3 each turn for %d turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
腐蚀性酸雾从地面升起，在半径 3 格内每回合造成 %0.2f 点酸性伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +4 魔法，+2 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source: Releases stinging spores at the target, blinding it for %d turns.
entries.target: 向目标喷射孢子，使目标致盲 %d 回合。

entries.source: The target's dreams have been broken by the dreamforge, reducing its mental save by %d and reducing its chance of successfully casting a spell by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被梦境熔炉打破梦境，精神豁免降低 %d，施法成功率降低 %d%%。

entries.source: cure up to %d diseases or poisons (based on Magic)
entries.target: 治愈至多%d项疾病和毒素。（基于魔法）

entries.source:
Surround yourself with a Tempest, increasing all your lightning damage by %d%% and ignoring %d%% lightning resistance of your targets.
		Your Lightning and Chain Lightning spells also gain a %d%% chance to daze, and your Thunderstorm spell gains a %d%% chance to daze.
entries.target:
在你周围生成一股风暴，增加你 %d%% 闪电伤害并无视目标 %d%% 闪电抗性。
		你的闪电术和连锁闪电同时会增加 %d%% 眩晕几率，并且闪电风暴也会增加 %d%% 眩晕几率。

entries.source: This creature has fallen into a solipsistic state and is caught up in its own egoic thoughts (-%d%% global speed).
entries.target: 目标进入唯我状态并且被自己的思维所干扰 (-%d%% 全局速度 )。

entries.source:
Over the next %d turns you'll fire up to %d arrows at this target from this location, each dealing %d%% weapon damage to the target. 
		These shots do not consume ammo.
entries.target:
在下面的 %d 回合中，你从当前所在位置对目标发射最多 %d 支灵矢，每支对目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		这些射击不消耗弹药。
巫医库贝克的实验笔记
